item.title: Dharmendra’s passing: From Harbhajan Singh to Suresh Raina – Indian cricket fraternity mourns the demise of Bollywood legend
item.description: Veteran Bollywood legend Dharmendra passed away on Monday morning at his Mumbai residence at age of 89. The Indian cricket fraternity paid heartfelt tributes to the Indian legend.

item.title: WPL 2026: Complete list of players to register for Women’s Premier League mega auction with their base price
item.description: WPL 2026 Mega Auction will brings together 277 registered players fighting for just 73 vacancies across five teams. New Delhi is gearing up for a major showdown on November 27.

item.title: IND vs SA: Karun Nair’s cryptic post ignites selection debate amid India’s batting collapse on Day 3 of Guwahati Test
item.description: Karun Nair posted a cryptic message on social media amid Team India's struggle on Day 3 of second Test. India’s only notable resistance came from a gritty 72-run partnership between Washington Sundar and Kuldeep Yadav.

item.title: WPL 2026: 3 franchises that can target Amelia Kerr in the mega auction
item.description: New Zealand star Amelia Kerr is expected to raise the bar in the WPL 2026 mega auction. Kerr was released ahead of the auction by Mumbai Indians.

item.title: IPL 2026: 5 teams that can target Andre Russell in the mini-auction
item.description: Andre Russell was released by Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) ahead of the IPL 2026 mini-auction. Russell remains one of the most destructive finishers in T20 cricket, boasting a phenomenal career strike rate of over 174 in the IPL.

item.title: SL vs ZIM, T20I Tri-series 2025: Who will win today’s match between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe?
item.description: Sri Lanka will take on Zimbabwe in Match 5 of Pakistan T20I Tri-Series 2025. Sri Lanka's campaign has been a nightmare so far, suffering two heavy defeats.

item.title: AS-W vs BH-W, WBBL|11 Match Prediction: Who will win today’s game between Adelaide Strikers and Brisbane Heat?
item.description: Adelaide Strikers will take on Brisbane Heat in Match 23 of Women's Big Bash League 2025. Both teams are positioned at the bottom two spots in the points table.

item.title: Stuart Broad reveals strategy for England to counter Travis Head in Ashes 2025-26
item.description: Stuart Broad has offered a blueprint for how England can silence Australia's Travis Head in the remaining matches of Ashes 2025-26. Head’s blistering century in the fourth innings of the first Test in Perth set the tone for Australia’s 1-0 lead.

item.title: IND vs SA [WATCH]: Ravindra Jadeja delivers a peach to get rid of Aiden Markram on Day 4 of the Guwahati Test
item.description: Ravindra Jadeja delivered a sensational jaffa to dismiss Aiden Markram on Day 4 of the Guwahati Test. South Africa steadily extended their massive lead building a commanding position after India’s batting collapse.
